projects.title: TrueTest — Autonomous E2E Testing
projects.description: Katalon's autonomous testing platform that turns production web traffic into executable end-to-end test suites. I ship full-stack into the product and the internal operations console as Product Engineer and Support Lead.
highlights: Closed the loop from customer to code: ran support communication and triage, then implemented the fixes and shipped the features myself.

Built session search across both the Athena and ClickHouse execution paths with server-side query validation, plus session-ID search and a raw-data inspection view that support uses to triage live customer sessions.

Shipped global AUT search by client code or name — per-token keyword matching ("iGO nlg" finds "iGO-NLG"), active AUTs ranked by the status users actually see, then reused it on the Support Mode client page.
Exposed Smart text exclusions in TrueTest Mode with a newline-delimited selector input, so CSS selectors containing commas and spaces are never silently corrupted.
AI-native delivery: small PRs paired with coding agents, each landing with unit coverage across React components and Java query builders so support-critical paths cannot silently regress.

projects.title: Scriptorium — AI Teammate That Asks Before It Acts
projects.description: Open-source AI teammate for Slack, Jira, Confluence, and GitHub. It answers with citations or says it doesn't know, proposes tickets, pages, and edits, and changes nothing until a named person approves the exact change. Built AI-native: an agent loop ships it every half hour behind a gate a human controls.
highlights: Rules are enforced in code, not by prompt: every tool call passes one policy check, unlisted tools are denied and never offered, and every write waits on a signed, single-use approval bound by hash to the exact arguments shown on the Slack card.

Grounding contract — no citation, no claim. Answers must cite a Jira issue, Confluence page, PR, Slack message, or doc a tool actually fetched; unsupported claims are refused and the gap becomes a ticket.

Exactly-once writes across lost responses and restarts, separation of duties across Slack/Jira/GitHub identities, a hash-chained audit log that detects edited or reordered lines, plus kill switch, spend caps, and rate-limit backoff for operators.

AI-native build loop: an agent ships up to five changes every 30 minutes — research against production needs, small commits each with the eval that proves it, an adversarial review that tries to break each feature, then typecheck, 500+ evals, and CI before a pull request a person merges.
Every safety rule has a mutant that must be caught — mutation tests break each guardrail on purpose in CI to prove the guard is real.

Scale: 253 commits since Aug 2026, 8 packages + 1 app in a strict-TypeScript monorepo, 11 skills as reviewable markdown, 500+ tests and evals; runs as one container on Anthropic API, Claude on Vertex, or Gemini.

projects.title: Kally — Ambient AI Teammate (downstream of Thor)
projects.description: An ambient AI teammate that lives in Slack and acts on Salesforce, Jira, Confluence, and GitHub as the human who summoned it — every action attributable, auditable, and revocable. Downstream of scoutqa-dot-ai/thor by @daohoangson.
highlights: Downstream of scoutqa-dot-ai/thor — original architecture (gateway → runner → opencode → remote-cli, mitmproxy outbound, vouch ingress) authored by @daohoangson at ScoutQA.ai. My scope: 64 commits rebranding and extending the system as Kally.

Per-user credential injection in two modes: args mode (Kally-owned Salesforce MCP, plaintext lives one Python subprocess) and connection mode (hosted Atlassian MCP, per-user StreamableHTTP session pool, 30-min idle TTL).

Approval flow stamps the requester's Slack UID; at resolve time the proxy re-fetches the requester's vault credentials so week-old approvals still authenticate as the person who proposed them — not the reviewer, not a service account.
AES-256-GCM vault with per-record IV, append-only audit.jsonl, bearer auth with timingSafeEqual, no host port. Plaintext credentials never appear in the audit log.

PR review protocol uses real git worktrees — every diff, grep, test, and type-check runs against `git worktree add /workspace/worktrees/<repo>/pr-<N>`. CI failures: pulls failed logs, classifies defect vs flake, auto-fixes up to 3 attempts per branch before escalating.
Scale: 11 packages, 45 test files, 733 tests, ~39k LOC TypeScript, 9 Cloud Run services.

projects.title: Cloud-Native E-Commerce
projects.description: Cloud-native microservices commerce platform: React microfrontends and .NET 10 services on AWS EKS with Istio, Terraform, Kustomize/Helm, and a full observability stack.
highlights: 4 .NET 10 microservices (Catalog, Basket, Discount, Ordering) on Clean Architecture + CQRS behind an Ocelot gateway, event-driven via RabbitMQ/MassTransit with gRPC between Basket and Discount.
5-app React microfrontend (Module Federation + Nx): host shell plus Store, Checkout, Account, and Admin remotes sharing auth and layout packages.

AWS EKS provisioned with Terraform and IRSA; single Kustomize tree with manifest validation in CI, Helm charts for services and data stores, Istio mTLS, and Prometheus/Grafana/Jaeger/Elastic observability.
Hardened the backend with RFC 7807 problem details, fail-fast startup, and data-integrity fixes; unit, integration, and k6 load tests plus an e2e smoke test on a fresh compose stack.
10 GitHub Actions workflows (CI/CD, Docker, Terraform, K8s deployment test, performance, SBOM and license, release), an Astro Starlight docs site, and 23 GitHub stars.

projects.title: FiveD Pulse — Live Engineering Platform
projects.description: Real-time engineering pulse for FiveD Studio — Bun + Hono + Postgres backend that ingests every GitHub event across the org and fans it out to the live dashboard over SSE in seconds.
highlights: Designed a single ingest pipeline: GitHub App webhook → HMAC verify → normalize → Postgres event stream, with Redis fan-out to SSE clients and daily rollups.
Real-time fan-out via Redis stream so multiple Cloud Run instances broadcast consistently and reconnecting clients catch up cleanly.
Idempotent ingest — delivery IDs are unique-keyed, redeliveries no-op; repo upserts target full_name so migrated repos converge.
Schema-first with Drizzle migrations; sub-second cold starts and ~50ms p50 reads on Bun + Hono.
LeetCode leaderboard worker polls leetcode.com/graphql every 6h and caches in Postgres; weighted score easy×1 + medium×2 + hard×4.
Powers the live /live page at fived-studio.github.io — a Next.js 15 static export streaming events from the Pulse SSE endpoint.
